title: Turok - Evolution
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health; ammo
Side-scrolling shooter: Tal'Set (Turok) fights dinosaurs and the Slegs
Health bar; weapons switch with the shoulder buttons

rows: bow (silent, reusable arrows), guns with limited ammo, heavier weapons later

widgets.text: Melee knife attack for close dinosaurs when ammo is low

rows: keep distance and fire on the approach

widgets.text: Bosses are large dinosaurs and Sleg commanders; aim for exposed weak points

Jungle levels
Jungle, cliffs and enemy bases across the Lost Land

Ammo
Ammo pickups per weapon; health packs from crates
Switch to the bow when ammo runs low: arrows can be picked up again

Hidden items
Hidden ammo and health off the main path
Secret areas with ammo and health above the main route

Levels cleared
Levels in order to the final base
Each level ends at an exit after the last group of enemies or a boss
